name: modernrelay/omnigraph
title: Omnigraph versions shared agent data like Git
summary: Omnigraph is an open-source Rust graph database that puts each agent on its own branch and checks a merge against the latest main, so a stale write cannot erase another agent's change. Agents connect over MCP, a TypeScript SDK, or the CLI.
